name: KwikFlow Checkout Recovery Service
description: High-velocity checkout recovery system for Shopify storefronts that programmatically turns abandoned carts into review-ready draft orders with single-click payment links.

capabilities.name: Real-time Checkout Abandonment Detection
capabilities.description: Monitors checkout events and filters qualified buyers based on customer contact data and cart value thresholds.

capabilities.name: Automated Native Draft Order Generation
capabilities.description: Compiles customer shipping, items, variants, and dynamic recovery discounts into a native store Draft Order in ~1.2 seconds.

capabilities.name: One-Click Checkout Invoicing
capabilities.description: Produces pre-authenticated checkout links ready for multi-channel recovery over Email, SMS, Gorgias, and WhatsApp.

capabilities.name: Intelligent Inventory Protection
capabilities.description: Configurable stock reservation rules that safeguard high-velocity catalog inventory without risk of overselling.
